metadata.technology_specification: Triple Quadrupole Liquid Chromatography–Mass Spectrometry (LC–MS/MS) System
metadata.technology_reasoning: Triple quadrupole LC-MS systems are industry-standard analytical instruments used for quantitative and qualitative chemical analysis due to their high sensitivity and specificity. They dominate mass spectrometry for targeted analysis in pharmaceuticals, environmental testing, and food safety, leveraging three quadrupole mass filters in sequence for superior selectivity and fragmentation.

components.reasoning: This module separates sample components prior to mass spectrometry and is universally present as a distinct subsystem with its own flow path and components.
Allows introduction of the sample into the LC stream; typically procured as a separate, replaceable module.

components.component: Ion Source (e.g., Electrospray Ionization or Atmospheric Pressure Chemical Ionization)
components.reasoning: Crucial for converting liquid analytes into gas-phase ions; a primary component with dedicated supply chains.
Performs initial mass filtering; a core component unique to triple quadrupole MS systems.
Provides collision-induced dissociation for fragmenting selected ions; essential for tandem MS operation.
Final mass analysis stage filtering product ions; critical for quantitation and selectivity.
Maintains required low-pressure environment essential for ion transmission and detection; a distinct subsystem with dedicated manufacture.

components.component: Mass Spectrometer Detector (Electron Multiplier or Alternative Detector)
components.reasoning: Detects ions exiting Q3; a separate electronic component critical to signal transduction.
Controls system operation and processes data; typically a modular electronics unit.
Structural enclosure integrating subsystems; usually procured or manufactured separately.
